records.text: A news reporter said the university was replacing the grass where Charlie Kirk had been speaking with pavers.
records.speaker: News reporter (unidentified)

appearances.snippet: This is the courtyard where it all happened. It's now open to the public again. There's lots of people coming here, placing flowers, cards, things like that. The university is already making some changes. They're replacing the grass where Charlie Kirk was speaking with pavers.

verification.notes: The embedded news clip directly records the reporter saying the university was replacing the grass where Kirk had spoken with pavers. Later public reporting and records also document paving at the courtyard.
